title: kitepon/aiterm-mcp
description: One persistent MCP terminal your AI drives — and launches other coding agents (Codex/Grok/Composer) into. SSH, containers, and REPLs nest as text you send in. tmux-backed, token-reduced reads, headless over MCP.
